description.zh: 在用户请求的地址不存在时展示的兜底页面：用一句人话说明发生了什么，提供返回首页、搜索或推荐入口，把一次失败访问转成继续浏览的机会。它不解决问题本身，但决定用户是离开还是留下。
description.en: A fallback screen for missing addresses. It explains the situation plainly and offers home, search or recommended links for a next step.

use_when.zh: 请求路径不存在或页面已下线
use_when.en: A requested path is missing or retired

use_when.zh: 用户输入或点击了错误链接
use_when.en: A user types or follows a broken link

use_when.zh: 内容被删除后仍需承接旧流量
use_when.en: Deleted content must still catch old traffic

avoid_when.zh: 服务端或后端故障（应使用 500 服务错误页）
avoid_when.en: Backend failures — use a server error page instead

avoid_when.zh: 未登录或权限不足（应引导登录或返回）
avoid_when.en: Authentication or permission gaps — route to login instead

avoid_when.zh: 旧链接可精确重定向到新地址（直接跳转即可）
avoid_when.en: Old links that can redirect precisely — just forward them

note.zh: 只有状态码、一句说明和一个返回入口
note.en: Just the code, one line of copy and a way back

note.zh: 提供搜索框与热门链接，帮用户自己找回目标
note.en: A search box and popular links so users can find their own target

note.zh: 用插画与推荐内容弱化失败感
note.en: An illustration and recommendations soften the dead end

note.zh: 用 404 加一句人话标题，先让用户明白没有崩。
note.en: A 404 with a plain-language heading so users know nothing crashed.

note.zh: 一句话解释地址不存在，避免技术术语与自责语气。
note.en: One sentence explaining the missing address, free of jargon or blame.

note.zh: 轻量插画或图标，弱化失败感但不喧宾夺主。
note.en: A light illustration or icon that softens the failure without dominating.

note.zh: 主按钮返回首页，次入口返回上一页或联系支持。
note.en: A primary home button and secondary back or support links.

note.zh: 搜索框或热门链接，把用户带向下一步而不是终点。
note.en: A search box or popular links that point to a next step, not a dead end.

notes.zh: 整页用 min-height 100vh 加 flex 居中，内容宽度限制在 48ch 内保证文案可读。状态码可用大号 font-serif 做视觉锚点， 搜索框与推荐链接放在同一 max-width 容器内。服务器返回真实 404 状态码，不要用 200 包裹错误页，否则搜索引擎会收录空页。
notes.en: Center the page with min-height 100vh plus flex, and cap the copy at 48ch for readability. Use a large font-serif status code as the visual anchor, with search and links inside the same max-width container. Return a real 404 status code rather than a 200 wrapper so search engines do not index empty pages.

basic.zh: 创建一个 404 页面，包含状态码、说明文案和返回首页按钮。
basic.en: Create a 404 page with a status code, a short message and a home button.

design.zh: 设计一个 404 页面：居中布局，大号 404 状态码，一句说明，插图或图标，主按钮返回首页，次入口返回上一页； 带搜索框与三个热门链接，深浅色一致，移动端优先。
design.en: Design a 404 page: centered layout with a large 404 code, one line of copy, an illustration or icon, a primary home button and a secondary back link. Add a search box and three popular links, keep light and dark consistent, and design mobile first.

implementation.zh: 用 React 加 Tailwind 实现 404 页面：搜索框受控并可在输入时过滤推荐链接；主按钮走路由返回首页； 确保服务端返回真实 404；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React plus Tailwind 404 page: a controlled search box that filters recommendations as you type, a primary button that routes home, a real 404 response from the server, respect for prefers-reduced-motion, and no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现 404 页面。

先检查现有路由、错误边界与设计 Token，优先复用。
要求：
- 居中布局：状态码、说明、插图、主次操作
 - 搜索框可过滤推荐链接
 - 服务端返回真实 404 状态码
 - 深浅色一致，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the 404 page in the current project.

Inspect existing routes, error boundaries and design tokens first; reuse them.
Requirements:
- Centered layout: code, message, illustration, primary and secondary actions
- Search box filters recommended links
- Server returns a real 404 status code
- Consistent light/dark; animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
